Purpose: Design review for native production trace execution. No production trace is collected. This review assesses whether the system is ready to proceed from ControlledReplay to a planned production trace capture. It does NOT execute capture — it only evaluates readiness criteria and produces a go/no-go decision.

DesignReviewResult.DesignReviewPassedReason: All review criteria satisfied. Production workspace/collection selection standards defined, privacy boundaries hardened, retention and audit trail established, idempotency plan specified, rollback plan documented, and no-runtime-influence invariant confirmed.
DesignReviewResult.ProductionTraceExecutionAllowedReason: Design review passed, but execution is NOT authorized at this phase. ProductionTraceExecutionAllowed=false because: (1) the execution endpoint has not been implemented beyond the skeleton, (2) no production workspace/collection has been designated, (3) the execution plan must be created as a separate phase (V16.13+). This gate only asserts design readiness, not execution authorization.

WorkspaceCollectionSelection.Standard: Production workspace must NOT be synthetic (native-ws, smoke-ws, dryrun-ws, etc.). Must be a real workspace with real user traffic. Collection must be a real collection containing actual context data. Synthetic IDs rejected per V16.9 synthetic detection rules.

RealTrafficBoundary.Criterion: Boundary between real user traffic and synthetic/seeded/controlled replay
RealTrafficBoundary.Boundary: ControlledReplay (V16.7) uses FileSystem-backed stores with seeded corpus — this is NOT production traffic. Production traffic requires real user-originated context items, tasks, and constraints from actual product usage. The boundary is: RealProductionTraffic = (NonFileSystem stores OR real user data) AND traceSource=3 AND not controlled-replay seeded.
RealTrafficBoundary.CurrentState: All existing traces (V16.4 dry-run, V16.7 controlled replay) are non-production. Zero production-native traces exist.

PrivacyBoundary.Criterion: Privacy: no raw prompt, raw content, secrets, or tokens in trace

TraceRetentionAndCleanup.Criterion: Trace retention, cleanup, and audit trail
TraceRetentionAndCleanup.RetentionPolicy: Trace files are plain JSONL on disk. No automatic retention enforcement. Manual cleanup by deleting files. Retention duration TBD by operator.
TraceRetentionAndCleanup.CleanupProcedure: Delete trace files from learning/v16_X/ directory. No side effects — no database mutation, no index corruption, no pipeline impact.
TraceRetentionAndCleanup.AuditTrail: Every trace row carries operationId, requestId, and recordedAt. Full provenance chain from operation to row.

RunIdIdempotency.Policy: RejectExistingRunId. Each runId is unique. If a trace file for a given runId already exists, the collection MUST fail with an idempotency error. No accidental overwrite.
RunIdIdempotency.ImplementationPlan: Before creating FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink, check if output path exists. If yes, log error and return. Do not proceed.

RollbackSteps: 1. If trace collection fails mid-execution, dispose the FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink.
3. Delete the partial trace file (if any).
4. Log the failure with operationId, exception, and timestamp.
5. No package output was mutated — no rollback of application state needed.
6. Retry with a new runId (never reuse the failed runId).
FailureRollbackPlan.NoApplicationStateRollbackReason: Trace collection is append-only diagnostic. Package output is unchanged. Vector binding is unchanged. No runtime state is modified.

NoRuntimeInfluenceInvariant.InvariantProof: Trace collection writes to FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink only. The sink is a simple JSONL appender. No scoring modification, no neural activation, no package mutation.

GateSemantics.NativeProductionTraceReadyNote: Even with review passed, NativeProductionTraceReady requires actual execution against production workspace/collection.

PhaseTransition.NextAllowedPhaseDescription: Create a detailed execution plan specifying: exact workspace/collection, token budget, expected row count range, validation thresholds, and metric quality pass criteria.
PhaseTransition.NextDisallowedPhaseReason: Runtime influence is permanently false. Neural bias, package mutation, and vector binding changes are structurally prohibited.
